description: This is a React component implementing a Todo List application, including state management, routing, and rendering logic.

classes.name: TodoApp
classes.description: Main React component managing Todo List interactions, rendering, and state.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up routing when component mounts.

methods.name: handleNewTodoKeyDown
methods.description: Handles creation of new Todo items on pressing Enter.

methods.name: toggleAll
methods.description: Toggles the completion state of all Todos.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the completion state of a specific Todo.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Enables editing mode for a specific Todo.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves changes to a Todo item.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the Todo application UI based on current state.
